label: DS-2 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the three-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 2 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit DISA and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the DISA source working identifier, individual DS-2 genes and proteins, the DS-2C HMM profile row, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, the absent DefenseFinder rule-level model, unresolved DS-2 effector chemistry, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
